text:
Priya: Quick nudge — cutoff for the 1.12.0 ship is 4:00pm PT today. If the infra regression fix isn't merged and green by 2:00pm PT, we should push the public announcement to tomorrow 9am PT.

Alex: I'm on the batching regression. PR is at draft -> pushing final tests now. ETA 1:25pm PT. If I miss 2pm I'll flag for a hotfix.

Priya: Thanks. If your PR lands after cutoff we'll consider a targeted hotfix; prefer not to split the main build. Please add `ship=critical` label if it must go in the release.

Mateo: Docs — where should changelog lines go? We can stitch them into the announcement if we have them.

Priya: Add lines to `docs/CHANGELOG/next.md` and put a short PR comment with the high-level bullet. Docs will pull from that file.

Jun: Plan: cut the RC branch at 3:00pm PT assuming the commit list is stable. If we have new commits after RC cut we either hold them for next patch or do a separate hotfix branch.

Sam: Can we do a canary rollout for the parts not touching batching? Suggest canary in us-west-2 only and hold global rollout.

Priya: Yes — Canary to us-west-2 only. Jun, can you coordinate the canary window and remove regions if infra tests fail?

Jun: Yep. I'll schedule canary starting at 3:30pm PT, 30m window, health checks every 5m. If we see KV cache errors revert to previous task set.

Lara: Heads-up from security: if we slip the announce, update the internal incident note and let security review any user-facing migration notes.

Alex: PR merged at 1:22pm PT — integration tests are running, looks green so far. Added changelog bullet to `docs/CHANGELOG/next.md`.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled -> start 15:30 PT on us-west-2. Health checks: token-latency, 5xx-rate, kv-cache-errors.

Priya: Awesome. If anything regresses between 1:30–2:00pm ping me and @eng-oncall. Otherwise I'll draft the announcement for 6pm PT release window. :thumbsup: 

Alex: Will do. Thanks everyone.
